articles.title: The Diplomat's Allison Janney Explains What's Wrong With President Penn In Season 4
articles.summary: Allison Janney's fictional President Grace Penn faces a severe personal crisis in "The Diplomat" Season 4, grappling with the aftermath of surviving an assassination attempt outside Windsor Castle. The incident leaves her increasingly irritable, hinting at a dramatic and challenging new season for the character and the show's narrative focused on political intrigue and international relations.

articles.title: Putin's Giant Nuclear Missile EXPLODED in Its Own Silo... Satellite Photos Show a 60-Meter Crater
articles.summary: A catastrophic test failure of Russia's RS-28 Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile (NATO: SS-X-29/SS-X) occurred during a 2024 test. The missile, known for its strategic capabilities, reportedly failed without being armed with nuclear material. This incident highlights ongoing developments and challenges in advanced weaponry programs, crucial for aspirants to understand global defence dynamics.

articles.title: ‘Water ingress’ incident on Navy vessel, no casualties reported
articles.summary: An Indian Navy vessel recently experienced a water ingress incident. Authorities have confirmed that there were no casualties among the crew members, ensuring the safety of personnel despite the operational challenge. Investigations are likely underway to determine the cause of the incident and implement corrective measures to maintain naval operational readiness and safety standards for the fleet.

articles.title: Amit Shah says Sardar Patel did not get due recognition for contributions, flags off 'Run for Unity'
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel did not receive due recognition for his immense contributions for a long time. Shah alleged that the Opposition deliberately overlooked Patel's legacy. He emphasized the importance of acknowledging Patel's role in India's unification, highlighting a perceived historical injustice and criticizing political efforts to diminish his significance.

articles.title: Centre approves ₹989 crore for 39 road projects across Keralam
articles.summary: The Centre has approved Rs 988.75 crore for 39 crucial road development projects in Keralam, with construction expected to begin in December. State Public Works Minister P K Basheer announced this significant investment, which aims to enhance regional connectivity, improve logistics, and stimulate economic growth, reinforcing national infrastructure development efforts vital for overall progress.
